cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You don't think they let me win the race, do you? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 states authority but rejects B account outright; A5 knot claim does not negotiate endorsement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 slowing becomes A3 pace merit; B4 shoe reason becomes A5 preparation merit.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer observed facts that threaten A interpretation.

heightening.evidence: A5 shifts deserved credit to knots because B4 reveals shoe tying.

specificity.evidence: A1 race win and B2 slowing are enough context.
